templates.source: UniFi Protect UI (Settings → Advanced → RTSP): each camera generates a unique random token per quality level; the RTSP URL displayed is rtsp://{nvr_ip}:7447/{token} for plain RTSP, or rtsps://{nvr_ip}:7441/{token}?enableSrtp for encrypted. Confirmed by: CamTuber Ubiquiti RTSP guide (https://www.camtuber.com/rtsp-guide/ubiquiti), HostiFi guide (https://www.hostifi.com/blog/how-to-stream-a-unifi-protect-rtsp-feed-to-wordpress), VisioForge docs (https://www.visioforge.com/help/docs/dotnet/camera-brands/ubiquiti/). No static path exists — token is system-generated and shown in Protect UI.

Ubiquiti AirCam Streaming Manual (referenced at readkong.com/page/streaming-manual-for-the-aircam-unifi-video-camera-or-9711537): 'rtsp://<your local webcam IP address>/live/ch00_0 — 1280x720 px (HD)'. Port 554. Default credentials ubnt/ubnt. Also documented at GeniusVision community (https://community.geniusvision.net/platform/cprndr/modelrtsp/7710137223771791232) citing rtsp://ip-addr/live/ch00_0.
Ubiquiti AirCam Streaming Manual (same source as ch00_0 entry): '/live/ch01_0 — 640×368 px (Standard resolution)'. Port 554.

This is a device-specific unique RTSP token from a UniFi Protect system — not a reusable path template. Token is per-camera and shown only in the Protect UI. Port 7447 confirms UniFi Protect NVR origin. Excluded as template (token-based, not a fixed path).
Another device-specific unique RTSP token from a UniFi Protect system (port 7447). Not a reusable template. Excluded for same reason as /5e254c28900822014a06053a_0.

notes: Ubiquiti has two distinct RTSP paradigms: (1) UniFi Protect (modern): RTSP is proxied through the NVR/console on port 7447 (plain) or 7441 (encrypted RTSPS). Each camera gets a unique random token per quality tier (high/medium/low), shown in Protect UI under Settings → Advanced → RTSP. There is NO fixed path — the token changes if RTSP is disabled/re-enabled or the camera is reset. The full URL format is rtsp://{nvr_ip}:7447/{token} or rtsps://{nvr_ip}:7441/{token}?enableSrtp. (2) Legacy AirCam / early UniFi Video cameras: direct RTSP on port 554, fixed paths /live/ch00_0 (HD 1280×720), /live/ch01_0 (640×368), /live/ch02_0 (320×176), /live/ch03_0 (160×96). Default credentials ubnt/ubnt. No fixed-path RTSP template can be published for modern UniFi Protect cameras; the token must be retrieved from the Protect UI per camera.
